summary: Deprecated: outputs the index of the most recently triggered numbered signal input.
description: Signal To Index accepts a numbered series of signal inputs and outputs the index of the one that fired most recently on `index`, firing `signalTriggered` on every trigger. It is deprecated and hidden from the node picker: the States node covers the same need — mapping several triggers to one of a set of values — with named states and per-state values instead of bare indices.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use States instead.
runtimeBehavior: Inputs are numbered ports named "input 0", "input 1", … counting from 0 (displayed as "Signal 0", "Signal 1"); each is edge-triggered, and a per-port "Start Index" selector sets the initial index. Deprecated — an authoring tool should not create this node.
